title: filenode-server: reject client patch of server-set sha256
description: FileNode/set update accepts a patch that sets "sha256" without changing blobId; MemoryBackend applies it, so a client can store a digest that does not match the blob. draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 L215-217: the server MUST set sha256 to the digest of the stored blob. RFC 8620 §5.3: changing a server-set property is invalidProperties unless the value is identical. Found while implementing JMAP-01ba.2 (which only overrides sha256 when blobId is in the patch).
